routeInfo = self.view.params.value

	params = {"itemId":  routeInfo['itemId'], "itemClassId":  routeInfo['itemClassId'], "routeStepId": None, 'routeId': routeInfo['routeId']}

	if editType == 'edit':
		selection = self.view.custom.routeSteps.selection.data
		if len(selection) > 0:	params['routeStepId'] = selection[0]['routeStepId']

	system.perspective.openPopup('openRouteStepEditor', 'kanoa/mes/config/lots/routeStepEditor', {'value': params}, title = 'Route Step Editor', draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True)
	
	return

onChange.script:
#	system.perspective.print("rowdroppedData change droppedId %s draggedId%s"%(currentValue.value["droppedId"].value, currentValue.value["draggedId"].value))

	if not self.custom.userAction.canCreate: return
	if int(currentValue.value["droppedId"].value) == -1 and int(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value) == -1: return
	
	routesSteps = self.custom.routeSteps.data
#	system.perspective.print("Inserting row %s to row %s"%(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value, currentValue.value["droppedId"].value))
#	system.perspective.print("Removing row %s"%(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value))
	
	routesSteps.insert(int(currentValue.value["droppedId"].value), routesSteps.pop(int(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value)))
	self.custom.tableRowDroppedData = {'draggedId': -1, 'droppedId': -1}
	
	success, msg = system.kanoa.lot.reorderRouteSteps(routesSteps, self.custom.security.userId)
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Route Steps were not reordered %s'%(msg))
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', "Route Steps have been reordered")

	self.refreshBinding("custom.routeSteps.data")
	
	return
